skill.name: vision
skill.description: Analyze local or remote images through a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint. It supports descriptions, OCR, charts, diagrams, screenshots, and scanned documents.
skill.summary: Delegate image understanding and OCR to an OpenAI-compatible vision model.
skill.author: kotot

security_audit.summary: The two outbound HTTP findings are confirmed because the script posts image data and prompts to a configurable endpoint. Most other findings are documentation, placeholders, or restricted configuration access, but inherited project settings can silently redirect uploads.

remediation.issue: Project settings can select the destination for image uploads.
remediation.suggestion: Require an explicit trusted endpoint or user confirmation before using VISION_BASE_URL from project files. Display the resolved destination before transmission.

remediation.issue: Local image contents and prompts leave the machine during normal operation.
remediation.suggestion: Warn before sending sensitive files and support an endpoint allowlist or local-only mode.

content.user_title: Analyze Images with a Vision Model
content.value_statement: Text-only agents cannot inspect screenshots, diagrams, or scanned pages. This skill sends one image and a focused prompt to your configured vision model.
actual_capabilities: Accepts one local image path or HTTP image URL.
Encodes local image files as base64 data URLs.
Sends focused questions to an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint.
Returns the vision model response as plain text.
Provides a dry-run mode that previews the request without sending it.
limitations: Requires a configured vision endpoint and model.
Sends image content and prompts to the configured endpoint.
Processes one image per command invocation.
Does not verify OCR accuracy or model conclusions.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Screenshot Errors
use_cases.description: Read visible error messages and identify likely causes from application screenshots.

use_cases.title: Extract Scanned Text
use_cases.description: Transcribe text from receipts, forms, and scanned pages while preserving useful structure.

use_cases.title: Interpret Visual Research
use_cases.description: Summarize charts and diagrams, including labels, values, relationships, and visible caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Describe an Image
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [image path or URL]. Describe the main subjects, setting, visible text, and important details.

prompt_templates.title: Transcribe Visible Text
prompt_templates.prompt: Read [image path or URL]. Transcribe all visible text and preserve headings, lists, and table relationships.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Screenshot
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect [screenshot path]. Identify the exact error, affected component, likely cause, and evidence visible in the interface.

prompt_templates.title: Extract and Compare Evidence
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze [image path or URL] against [expected state]. List matches, discrepancies, uncertain details, and evidence for each conclusion.

best_practices: Use a specific question that names the details you need.
Verify the resolved endpoint before sending confidential images.
Ask the model to mark unreadable or uncertain content.
anti_patterns: Do not send secrets or regulated data to an untrusted endpoint.
Do not treat OCR output as authoritative without verification.
Do not request broad descriptions when exact values are required.

faq.question: Which image sources are supported?
faq.answer: The script accepts one local file path or one HTTP or HTTPS image URL.

faq.question: Does this skill require a specific provider?
faq.answer: No. It requires an OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint with vision support.

faq.question: Is an API key required?
faq.answer: Remote services usually require one. Local endpoints may accept an empty key.

faq.question: Where is configuration loaded from?
faq.answer: Environment variables have priority. The script can also read Claude settings and OpenClaw dotenv files.

faq.question: Can I inspect a request before sending it?
faq.answer: Yes. Use dry-run mode to preview the destination and request structure without transmitting the image.

faq.question: Does the skill guarantee accurate OCR?
faq.answer: No. Accuracy depends on image quality and the selected model. Verify important text and numerical values.
